verdict.rationale: Superpowers has its own documented autonomous execution mode. After you approve a plan, subagent-driven development dispatches tasks to subagents, reviews each one, and keeps going, often for a couple of hours without deviating (gh-6, gh-10, gh-18). Non-catastrophic ambiguities get a recorded ruling and work continues, so only destructive actions stop for a human (docs-2). However, every run is started interactively inside an agent session and requires approval first (docs-56), and nothing shows standalone automations that are set up once and then run in the background. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background automations, a way to define persistent automations that run without an active session, and independent hands-on confirmation of unattended background runs.
